about_the_game:
Orbs Orbs Orbs is a vibrant 2D puzzle platformer where precision meets chaos! Your goal is simple: clear the board of colourful orbs by clicking the screen to create a white ring that destroys them. But with six distinct orb types—each with its own physics and behaviour—every level becomes a dynamic challenge.

Orb Types:

  • Green – The balanced all-rounder

  • Blue – Large and slow-moving

  • Orange – Floats with almost no gravity

  • Teal – Small, light, and nimble

  • Red – Unpredictable and chaotic

  • Pink – Clones itself on impact

Puzzle Elements & Mechanics:

  •  Seesaws, rotating and moving platforms add an extra layer of strategy

  •  Red zones destroy your white ring, and certain areas can't be clicked

  •  Destructible green blocks can alter your approach

  •  Attraction and repelling zones manipulate movement

  •  A gravity-flipping button shakes things up!

Relaxing & Chaotic

With soothing ASMR-inspired sound effects and colourful, physics-based interactions, Orbs Orbs Orbs delivers a unique mix of relaxation and energetic puzzle-solving. Levels can be calming or wildly unpredictable depending on how many orbs are in play.

Play Again:

  • Your score is based on the number of attempts needed to clear the board.

  • You must secure at least two orbs to progress—but aiming for three is the ultimate challenge!

  • Track your personal best time and score for endless replayability

  • Whether you're looking for a casual, meditative experience or a high-score chase, Orbs Orbs Orbs will keep you clicking, strategizing, and coming back for more!
